summary: Applies SMAA-style screen-space antialiasing by detecting luminance or RGB edges and smoothing those edges in the current frame.

key_params.name: quality
key_params.note: Antialias quality preset: low, medium, high, ultra, or custom

key_params.name: edgedetectsource
key_params.note: Detect edges from luminance or RGB

key_params.name: cornerrounding
key_params.note: Corner rounding strength for custom quality

common_gotchas: This is per-frame antialiasing; it does not accumulate temporal samples.
Too-low edge thresholds can soften texture detail as well as polygon edges.
High quality and custom long search distances cost more GPU time.
Use Output Edges to debug missed or excessive smoothing.
key_concepts: Anti Alias TOP applies screen-space antialiasing to an already-rendered image.
Edge detection is based on luminance or RGB, not temporal history.
Quality presets trade GPU cost for smoother edges.
Custom quality exposes search-step and corner-rounding controls for tuning edge reconstruction.
Output Edges is the diagnostic view for checking what the node is smoothing.
It uses less memory than rendering the source with regular Render TOP antialiasing.
